chapterInfo.content:
24
Tertulo bɔ ɔsomafoɔ no ho nkuro
1Na ne nnannum soɔ no, Ɔsɔfopanin Anania ne mpanimfoɔ bi ne mmaranimfoɔ bi a ɔde Tertulo bae, na wɔbɛbɔɔ Paulo kwaadu kyerɛɛ amrado no. 2Na wɔfrɛɛ no no, Tertulo firii aseɛ bɔɔ nkuro sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ wo nti yɛanya asomdwoeɛ bebree ne ntotoeɛ a ɛnam wo nimdeɛ so aba ɔman yi mu nti, 3Felike, onimuonyamfoɔ, yɛde aseda gye daa wɔ mmaa nyinaa. 4Na mempɛ sɛ yɛsɛe wo berɛ pii nti, mesrɛ wo, fa wo ara w’ayamyie no tie yɛn kakraa bi. 5#Aso 17.6 Yɛahunu ɔbarima yi sɛ ɔyɛ obusufoɔ a ɔde mansotwe ba Yudafoɔ a wɔwɔ wiase nyinaa mu, na ɔyɛ Nasarefoɔ fekuo no mu panin. 6#Aso 21.28 Na ɔsɔ hwɛɛ sɛ ɔde efi bɛka asɔrefie nso na yɛkɔkyeree no. 7[Na anka yɛpɛɛ sɛ yɛfa yɛn mmara so bu no atɛn; na Ɔsafohene Lisia bae de aniɛden bɛgyee no yɛn nsam de no kɔe, na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn a wɔne no wɔ nkuro no sɛ wɔmmra wo nkyɛn;]#24.7 Tete atwerɛ afoforɔ a wɔgye to mu binom mfa nkyekyɛmu 7 no nka ho. 8#Aso 23.30enti wo ara wobisa no a, wobɛhunu deɛ enti a yɛne no rebɔ nkuro yi nyinaa. 9Na Yudafoɔ no nso foaa no so sɛ nsɛm yi te saa.
Paulo yi ne ho ano wɔ Felike anim
10Na amrado no nyamm Paulo sɛ ɔnkasa no, ɔbuaa sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ menim sɛ wofiri yɛɛ ɔman yi temmufoɔ adi mfirinhyia pii nti, mede akoma pa mereyi m’ano. 11#Aso 21.17 Wobɛtumi ahunu sɛ ɛmmoroo dadu nnammienu na mekɔɔ Yerusalem sɛ merekɔsɔre. 12Na wɔanhu me asɔrefie anaa hyia adan mu anaa kuro mu hɔ sɛ me ne obi rekasa, anaasɛ merehwanyan nkurɔfoɔ no mu, 13nanso wɔrentumi nkyerɛ me nnoɔma a enti wɔretoto m’ano yi ase. 14#Aso 24.5 Na yei deɛ, mepae mu meka mekyerɛ wo sɛ Ɔkwan a wɔfrɛ no sɛ Fekuo no mu na mesɔre m’agyanom Nyankopɔn, na megye nnoɔma a wɔatwerɛ no mmara ne adiyifoɔ mu nyinaa medi. 15#Dan 12.2; Yoh 5.28-29 Na mewɔ Nyankopɔn ho anidasoɔ a wɔn ara nso wɔhwɛ no kwan, sɛ owusɔreɛ a wɔn a wɔtene ne wɔn a wɔntene bɛsɔre no bɛba. 16#Aso 23.1 Na yei mu na mesɔ me ho mehwɛ, sɛ mɛnya ahonim a ɛnni fɔ Nyankopɔn ne nnipa fam daa.
17 # Rom 15.25-26; Gal 2.10 Na mfirinhyia bebree akyiri no, mebaa sɛ mede ayɛyɛdeɛ merebrɛ me man na mabɛbɔ afɔdeɛ; 18#Aso 21.27 ɛno mu na wɔhunuu me sɛ meredwira me ho asɔrefie hɔ, nso ɛnyɛ me ne nkurɔfokuo, anaasɛ meyɛɛ gyegyeegye biara. 19Na ɛyɛ Yudafoɔ bi a wɔfiri Asia, wɔn na anka ɛsɛ sɛ wɔba w’anim ha, na sɛ wɔwɔ me ho asɛm bi a, wɔne me abɛbɔ nkuro. 20Anaasɛ ma wɔnka sɛ megyina badwafoɔ no anim no, wɔhunuu me ho adeɛ a ɛntene bi anaa, 21#Aso 23.6 gye asɛm baako yi a megyina wɔn mu no, meteaa mu mekaa sɛ: Awufoɔ sɔreɛ ho na morebu me atɛn nnɛ yi.
22 # Aso 23.26 Na Felike nim Ɔkwan no ho asɛm no mu yie nti, ɔkaa sɛ montwentwɛn so kakra na sɛ: Ɔsafohene Lisia ba a, na mɛtie asɛm no mu yie. 23#Aso 27.3 Na ɔhyɛɛ asraafoɔ ɔha so panin no sɛ ɔmfa no nsie, na wɔnnyɛ no biribiara, na ne ho nnipa bi bɛsom no anaasɛ ɔba ne nkyɛn a, ɔnnkame no.
Felike tu asɛm no hyɛ mfeɛ mmienu
24Na nna bi akyiri no, Felike ne ne yere Drusila a ɔyɛ Yudani bae, na ɔsoma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ Paulo baeɛ, na wɔtiee Kristo Yesu mu gyidie no ho asɛm. 25Na ɔreka tenenee ne anidahɔ ne atemmuo a ɛreba no ho asɛm no, Felike suroe, na ɔkaa sɛ: Seesei deɛ, kɔ, na menya adagyeɛ a, mɛma wɔabɛfrɛ wo. 26Na n’ani da so nso sɛ Paulo bɛma no sika na wagyaa no; enti na daa ɔma wɔkɔfrɛ no, na ɔne no bɔ nkɔmmɔ. 27Na mfirinhyia mmienu duruiɛ no, Porkio Festo bɛsii Felike ananmu; na Felike pɛɛ sɛ ɔsɔ Yudafoɔ ani nti, ɔgyaa Paulo wɔ afiase hɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ne nnannum soɔ no, Ɔsɔfopanin Anania ne mpanimfoɔ bi ne mmaranimfoɔ bi a ɔde Tertulo bae, na wɔbɛbɔɔ Paulo kwaadu kyerɛɛ amrado no. Na wɔfrɛɛ no no, Tertulo firii aseɛ bɔɔ nkuro sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ wo nti yɛanya asomdwoeɛ bebree ne ntotoeɛ a ɛnam wo nimdeɛ so aba ɔman yi mu nti, Felike, onimuonyamfoɔ, yɛde aseda gye daa wɔ mmaa nyinaa. Na mempɛ sɛ yɛsɛe wo berɛ pii nti, mesrɛ wo, fa wo ara w’ayamyie no tie yɛn kakraa bi. Yɛahunu ɔbarima yi sɛ ɔyɛ obusufoɔ a ɔde mansotwe ba Yudafoɔ a wɔwɔ wiase nyinaa mu, na ɔyɛ Nasarefoɔ fekuo no mu panin. Na ɔsɔ hwɛɛ sɛ ɔde efi bɛka asɔrefie nso na yɛkɔkyeree no. [Na anka yɛpɛɛ sɛ yɛfa yɛn mmara so bu no atɛn; na Ɔsafohene Lisia bae de aniɛden bɛgyee no yɛn nsam de no kɔe, na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn a wɔne no wɔ nkuro no sɛ wɔmmra wo nkyɛn;] enti wo ara wobisa no a, wobɛhunu deɛ enti a yɛne no rebɔ nkuro yi nyinaa. Na Yudafoɔ no nso foaa no so sɛ nsɛm yi te saa.

Na amrado no nyamm Paulo sɛ ɔnkasa no, ɔbuaa sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ menim sɛ wofiri yɛɛ ɔman yi temmufoɔ adi mfirinhyia pii nti, mede akoma pa mereyi m’ano. Wobɛtumi ahunu sɛ ɛmmoroo dadu nnammienu na mekɔɔ Yerusalem sɛ merekɔsɔre. Na wɔanhu me asɔrefie anaa hyia adan mu anaa kuro mu hɔ sɛ me ne obi rekasa, anaasɛ merehwanyan nkurɔfoɔ no mu, nanso wɔrentumi nkyerɛ me nnoɔma a enti wɔretoto m’ano yi ase. Na yei deɛ, mepae mu meka mekyerɛ wo sɛ Ɔkwan a wɔfrɛ no sɛ Fekuo no mu na mesɔre m’agyanom Nyankopɔn, na megye nnoɔma a wɔatwerɛ no mmara ne adiyifoɔ mu nyinaa medi. Na mewɔ Nyankopɔn ho anidasoɔ a wɔn ara nso wɔhwɛ no kwan, sɛ owusɔreɛ a wɔn a wɔtene ne wɔn a wɔntene bɛsɔre no bɛba. Na yei mu na mesɔ me ho mehwɛ, sɛ mɛnya ahonim a ɛnni fɔ Nyankopɔn ne nnipa fam daa.
Na mfirinhyia bebree akyiri no, mebaa sɛ mede ayɛyɛdeɛ merebrɛ me man na mabɛbɔ afɔdeɛ; ɛno mu na wɔhunuu me sɛ meredwira me ho asɔrefie hɔ, nso ɛnyɛ me ne nkurɔfokuo, anaasɛ meyɛɛ gyegyeegye biara. Na ɛyɛ Yudafoɔ bi a wɔfiri Asia, wɔn na anka ɛsɛ sɛ wɔba w’anim ha, na sɛ wɔwɔ me ho asɛm bi a, wɔne me abɛbɔ nkuro. Anaasɛ ma wɔnka sɛ megyina badwafoɔ no anim no, wɔhunuu me ho adeɛ a ɛntene bi anaa, gye asɛm baako yi a megyina wɔn mu no, meteaa mu mekaa sɛ: Awufoɔ sɔreɛ ho na morebu me atɛn nnɛ yi.
Na Felike nim Ɔkwan no ho asɛm no mu yie nti, ɔkaa sɛ montwentwɛn so kakra na sɛ: Ɔsafohene Lisia ba a, na mɛtie asɛm no mu yie. Na ɔhyɛɛ asraafoɔ ɔha so panin no sɛ ɔmfa no nsie, na wɔnnyɛ no biribiara, na ne ho nnipa bi bɛsom no anaasɛ ɔba ne nkyɛn a, ɔnnkame no.

Na nna bi akyiri no, Felike ne ne yere Drusila a ɔyɛ Yudani bae, na ɔsoma maa wɔkɔfrɛɛ Paulo baeɛ, na wɔtiee Kristo Yesu mu gyidie no ho asɛm. Na ɔreka tenenee ne anidahɔ ne atemmuo a ɛreba no ho asɛm no, Felike suroe, na ɔkaa sɛ: Seesei deɛ, kɔ, na menya adagyeɛ a, mɛma wɔabɛfrɛ wo. Na n’ani da so nso sɛ Paulo bɛma no sika na wagyaa no; enti na daa ɔma wɔkɔfrɛ no, na ɔne no bɔ nkɔmmɔ. Na mfirinhyia mmienu duruiɛ no, Porkio Festo bɛsii Felike ananmu; na Felike pɛɛ sɛ ɔsɔ Yudafoɔ ani nti, ɔgyaa Paulo wɔ afiase hɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
